Re-skin it by editing the @theme tokens in src/app/styles/globals.css.

gallery.title: Component Gallery
gallery.subtitle: Every shared/ui primitive, live.
gallery.primitivesDescription: Badges, spinners, status dots, glass surfaces, tooltips, and pending states — the small vocabulary everything else is built from.
gallery.tooltipBody: Tooltips pin to one fixed surface level so they read identically everywhere.
gallery.infoTooltipBody: An info-icon tooltip used next to labels across the settings UI.
gallery.pendingHint: Flip the toggle — the corner badge spins while it's on.
gallery.buttonsDescription: The unstyled Button base composed into the app's accent / neutral / danger looks, icon buttons, and connected groups.
gallery.iconButtonDisabledTooltip: Disabled buttons still explain themselves on hover.
gallery.formDescription: Text fields, secrets, input groups, steppers, sliders, toggles, switchers, and checkbox groups — all substrate-aware, all self-elevating.
gallery.textFieldCaption: A plain TextField inside a FormControl row.
gallery.selectsDescription: Menu-based selects (flat and grouped), the searchable combobox, a creatable preset picker, and an editable tag list.
gallery.pickersDescription: The generic item picker (fuzzy search, groups, pinned favorites, keyboard traversal, hover spec cards), the universal item card, and the multi-select combobox.
gallery.demoDescSync: Keeps two catalogs in step across machines with conflict-free merges.
gallery.demoDescCache: A tiny write-through cache with pluggable eviction policies.
gallery.demoDescQueue: Priority job queue with retry backoff and dead-letter parking.
gallery.cardShelfHint: shelf slot — variant pills, download actions, …
gallery.modesDescription: Animated segmented mode switchers (2–5 modes, arrow-key navigation) and the compact cycle-on-click pill used in the footer.
gallery.rowModePill: Pill (click or arrow keys to cycle)
gallery.overlaysDescription: The shared dialog primitive in plain / confirm / opt-in / free-form modal modes, transient toasts, and the fail-soft remote demo preview.
gallery.demoPreviewHint: Fetches a .webm from your docs CDN on hover; fails soft when offline.
gallery.dialogBody: Dialogs lift four surface levels above their substrate and share one animation, radius, and footer treatment.
gallery.confirmBody: This is the destructive confirm treatment — alert semantics, danger action, focus trap.
gallery.optInBody: The opt-in dialog treats Escape and backdrop clicks as cancel — consenting requires an explicit button press.
gallery.modalBody: The Modal wrapper gives content full control of its own width, padding, and layout while sharing the dialog chrome and elevation ramp.
gallery.motionDescription: Animated numbers, icon swaps, scrolling text, staggered reveals, the Dynamic Island shell, and the media scrubber — all on the shared spring tiers.
gallery.scrollingTextBody: Long-running live text scrolls inside a fixed-height viewport, dissolving at the edges instead of clipping. New lines push old ones up smoothly, exactly like the live transcription pill this was built for.
gallery.staggerLine1: Lines cascade in with a small stagger.
gallery.staggerLine2: Each one fades, lifts, and unblurs.
gallery.staggerLine3: Driven by the shared CSS recipe.
gallery.dataDescription: The vendored DiceUI data grid (editable, filterable, undoable), the calendar heatmap with generated activity, and the entry-card list.
gallery.entryCardBody1: Entry cards pair a free-form body with a recessed meta shelf stepped one surface below the card.
gallery.entryCardBody2: The accent rail types the whole card; meta chips carry icons, tooltips, and truncation.
gallery.downloadsDescription: The progress bar and tri-state action row the download manager is built from, exercised with static and interactive states.

dropZone.sectionDescription: File drop targets and drag-to-reorder lists. The drop zone listens to the native Tauri window drag-drop stream (absolute paths included) with a click-to-browse dialog fallback; sorting is dnd-kit with full keyboard support.

sortable.listHint: Drag a handle, or focus it and press Space, then move with the arrow keys.

crud.caption: Add rows, edit cells inline, delete via the selection bar, and sort/filter from the toolbar — changes persist locally across restarts.

charts.sectionDescription: Bespoke SVG charts ported from WinSTT's history dashboard — no charting library, theme tokens only, with the shared-tooltip hover pattern. The calendar heatmap in the Data section belongs to the same family.

settingsField.resetDescription: Restore this setting to its default value?
settingsField.sectionDescription: The DRY settings-row primitive the Settings window consumes — label, caption, info tooltip, control slot, and a per-setting reset affordance gated behind a confirm dialog.
settingsField.demoVolumeTooltip: Compared against the schema default — the reset arrow lights up when the value drifts.
settingsField.demoNotifyCaption: Show a toast when a download completes.
settingsField.demoChildCaption: Gated until the parent toggle is on.
settingsField.demoErrorCaption: Any value outside 1–65535 shows the inline error.
settingsField.demoShortcutCaption: Purely presentational keycap chips, ported from WinSTT's shortcuts legend.

hotkeys.toggleMainCaption: Global shortcut that shows or hides the DimRead window — it works while any app has focus.

overlay.galleryDescription: The native notification pill: a transparent, click-through, always-on-top window docked to the top of the screen. These buttons drive the real thing (Tauri runtime only).
overlay.demoMessage: This is a {tone} notification fired from the gallery demo.
overlay.hotkeyHint: Bind “Toggle main window” in Settings → General, then press it anywhere — every trigger broadcasts hotkey:triggered and lights a toast here.

displayTab.title: Display
displayTab.subtitle: Tune blue-light filtering, brightness and colour temperature.
displayTab.modePauseDesc: Filtering off — true colours at full brightness.
displayTab.modeHealthDesc: Balanced blue-light reduction for everyday work.
displayTab.modeGameDesc: Light filtering that keeps games crisp and responsive.
displayTab.modeMovieDesc: Warmer, dimmer tone tuned for watching video.
displayTab.modeOfficeDesc: Comfortable warmth for long hours of office work.
displayTab.modeEditingDesc: Inverts screen colours for low-light reading and editing.
displayTab.modeReadingDesc: Full-screen grayscale, like e-ink, for distraction-free reading.
displayTab.modeReadingGrayscaleUnavailable: Reading temperature and brightness are active, but full-screen grayscale is unavailable on this display backend.
displayTab.modeCustomDesc: Your own colour temperature and brightness.
displayTab.timeSourceCaption: Compute sun times from your location, or set them yourself.
displayTab.transitionCaption: How long the fade between day and night takes.

optionsTab.title: Options
optionsTab.subtitle: Configure how DimRead behaves.
optionsTab.autostartCaption: Start DimRead automatically when you sign in.
optionsTab.minimizeToTrayCaption: Keep running in the tray when the main window closes.
optionsTab.languageLocked: More languages are coming; only English is available for now.
optionsTab.reducedMotionCaption: Minimize animations regardless of the system preference.
optionsTab.advancedColorApiCaption: Fallback colour method for GPUs that misbehave.
optionsTab.smoothTransitionCaption: Animate colour and brightness changes instead of snapping between values.
optionsTab.wideRangeCaption: Extend the temperature range to 0-10000 K (default 1000-6500 K).
optionsTab.wideRangeWarning: Temperatures above 6500 K increase blue-light exposure and are not recommended.
optionsTab.brightnessWideRangeCaption: Extend the brightness range down to 0% (default floor 10%).
optionsTab.brightnessWideRangeWarning: 0% brightness dims the screen to fully black, which can make it hard to see.
optionsTab.fullscreenDetectionCaption: Turn the filter off automatically while a full-screen app or game is in the foreground.
optionsTab.hotkeysCaption: Click record on a row, then press a key combination. Function keys and modifier combos are supported.

aboutTab.title: About
aboutTab.description: An open-source eye-protection app: blue-light filter, gamma brightness and per-app display modes.
aboutTab.openSource: Fully open source — no accounts, licences or activation.
aboutTab.monitorInfoCaption: The displays DimRead can adjust. Handy details when reporting an issue.

rulesTab.title: Rules
rulesTab.subtitle: Switch modes automatically when a chosen app is in the foreground.
rulesTab.empty: No rules yet. Add one to switch modes per app.
rulesTab.finderToolCaption: Pick an open app to fill in the pattern below.

focusTab.title: Focus
focusTab.subtitle: Highlight what you are reading and dim the rest
focusTab.readCaption: A clear band follows your cursor while the rest of the screen is dimmed.
focusTab.blurCaption: Dim every background window so the active one stands out.
focusTab.adminHint: Windows from apps running as administrator can't be detected, so they won't be highlighted.

magicxTab.title: MagicX
magicxTab.subtitle: Per-window dark mode and automatic theme switching
magicxTab.magicWindowCaption: Apply a dark (invert) or grayscale effect to any single window.
magicxTab.toolbarCaption: When enabled, hovering the top of a window shows the Magic Toolbar; otherwise these effects are only available via hotkeys.
magicxTab.autoDarkCaption: Schedule the Windows system theme automatically.
magicxTab.themeNote: Some apps don't follow the Windows theme setting.
